review: Reviewed the release ui-1dffa0701c0a (source cd6b3e87, public ui-source history; Core and Smart are the same ui commit, Smart in distr/smart). One shared Smart runtime per page: lit, smart-base, page language, position and control spacing live in core/js/smart-base.js, which Core fetches the first time a Smart element is queued; a Smart bundle waits for it (SF.runtimeModule) and defines its element when it arrives. loader.js fetches minified bundles and lazy relations. The lessons' attributes, properties, events, slots, nesting, cleanup and assets do not change; a page that assembles its scripts by hand includes core/js/smart-base.js after core.js. The lessons moved into the guide's part 7 pages (structure holds creating and local components, composite holds nesting, lifecycle holds cleanup, templates holds templates and assets). loader.js at ui-0b8e5c559207 fetches an element's script while its relations load; the lessons do not change. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-84c7312396f6; the page language is read from the nearest [lang] past shadow roots, which the language guide states. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-45c15e706fde. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-82fc0ba882ba. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-86580e83da1b. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-a362f55f864c. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-3a39d8661e65. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-7606ca8693c1. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-3a3949fae1b7. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-d5db9dac5458. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-c95d35179e84. At ui-ed193b6adfda core gains placeholder shapes (data-sf-skeleton) and the manifest presentation.skeleton, documented in the states chapter; loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical. At ui-1dffa0701c0a loader.js changes only how it scans: an attribute change checks the element itself, added children are scanned when added; the lessons (when an element loads, whenDefined, relations) do not change. The field-renderers lesson (SF.fieldRenderers: the four modes, the field descriptor, the host methods, how a page loads the set) is reviewed against src/smart/field-renderers at cd6b3e87; its «Типы свойств» table is generated by scripts/build-property-types-reference.mjs. At ui-d7685ca01ec3 (source 88861c5e) loader.js adds SF.whenFieldRenderers(), which loads the field renderer set once from the Smart base and settles when any bundle publishes it (event sf-field-renderers-ready), and the registry lists only the keys the renderers read: readonly returns the view for every type, placeholder is read by string, text and the record picker, required by date, choice, choices, the record picker and include. The field-renderers lesson uses SF.whenFieldRenderers() instead of a hand-added script and polling; smart-base.js and the other lessons do not change. At ui-945c2ef505cc (source bfd5b805) loader.js runs a queued load on the next frame or after 100 ms, whichever comes first, so a Smart tag created by script in an out-of-view frame is still fetched, and Loader and icon storage go through core/js/page-storage.js, which falls back to memory where storage is denied (a frame sandboxed without allow-same-origin). The lessons do not change. At ui-7cbf3a19a7a7 (source 5d21c8c6) only sf-context-menu changes (a panel with tabs); loader.js, smart-base.js and the field renderers are unchanged and the lessons do not change. At ui-8711cf7df562 (source b09c469d) the core gains the interface-fragment descriptor check, seven page value types and SF.RegionNavigation, documented in the layouts part; loader.js, smart-base.js and the field renderers are byte-identical and the lessons do not change. At ui-376117eac4fe (source 7d6d95c0) smart-base.js reports a component that throws while it draws: the error is still logged, the element gets data-sf-error and emits sf-component-error {phase, message, element} instead of an unhandled rejection; At ui-3d6921cd2516 (source f6835d33, through ui-68a2e7c1167f and ui-0af51cddaa17) loader.js and field-renderers/registry.js are byte-identical. smart-base.js moves a data-* written on a Smart host to the native control it renders (the host keeps a record, element.dataAttributes, and removeHostDataAttribute() takes one off both) and sends focus() and blur() on the host to the control a component names in focusDelegate(); the templates lesson states that sf-button moves data-* to .sf-button, and the Buttons and Icon Buttons pages describe the record and the focus. field-renderers/index.js names the date, phone and yes/no edit controls with aria-label instead of a visible label, because the record panel prints the label itself; the field-renderers lesson already says the label reaches the edit element as aria-label or label. Core gains SF.ready (src/core/js/ready.js): a thenable on window.SF right after core.js that settles with window.SF at sf-loader-init, callable as SF.ready(fn), with the SF_ON_READY queue for scripts before core; the structure lesson's minimal component and the field-renderers lesson now wait with await SF.ready instead of a hand-written sf-loader-init listener. The open-surface mark keeps its holders in order (Escape closes the innermost layer), which the lessons do not use. The other lessons do not change. At ui-357568a20a7e (source 51002278, through ui-045432a6fb24) loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical; the field-renderer set adds the variant stepper for integer and number (edited with sf-quantity: min, max, step, a number's precision) and edits a single-image file field with sf-image-field; the field-renderers lesson states both in its setFieldValue table and its generated property-types table lists the variant and the new keys. The other lessons do not change. At ui-bc1fb36ec8f1 (source 9c4a9235, through ui-e84590925e63) smart-base.js and loader.js carry the shared Smart runtime and the first paint: the element layer (element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, instance-path) moved into core/js/smart-base.js and a bundle asks for it with SF.runtimeModule(id, abi), which the connection lesson and the loader page already state and which now names the size and the ABI; an element adopts its printed first paint in the base, renders only once its sheets are applied, and core draws no shape of its own before the code — a count alone reserves nothing and rows, record and menu keep the box the page declared, which the states chapter's «Заготовка до прихода кода» now states, with the preloader withheld on a page that printed its first paint. Core also sends a declared port's first call before any component's code (SF.EarlyPort), which the guide states in the Smart-components 2.0 section; the lessons' attributes, properties, events, slots, nesting, cleanup and assets do not change. The field renderers add the string params mask and nullable and the choice variant buttons (simai.property-view-port 1.16.0): the field-renderers lesson states the masked edit (the text as shown, an incomplete entry reported through setFieldError and never written, "" instead of null with nullable: false) and the segmented button group (size on the ladder, the chosen button pressed again clears an optional field, readonly and disabled drawn as the group draws them), and its generated property-types table lists both. On 2026-10-29 the guide keeps one Smart components section, the standard's: the old section's pages were removed and redirect to the standard's pages. The connection lesson's loading (a tag is enough, Loader by sfPath, a package component only on a page that declared its package) and waiting (SF.whenDefined, SF.createAsync, sf-after-render) moved to the page lesson; the field-renderers lesson stays as it was. The structure, properties, events, composite, slots, lifecycle and templates lessons described the SfBaseElement class model the standard replaced and were retired with the old section; loader.js, smart-base.js and the field renderers are unchanged.
